text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started (config-only) — change-window 14:30-15:00 UTC. Canary: 5% for 10m. Changes: max_inflight: 120 -> 90, per_tenant_timeout_s: 30 -> 25, batch_window_ms: 50 -> 40. Rollout ID: r-83f2. No model/version changes.
maya: ack — monitoring dashboards?
zack: yes, dashboards up. I'll watch p50/p95, error_rate, and kvcache_miss. watching 14:35-14:50. :eyes:
alex: small addition to rollback policy: if p50 > 300ms for > 1m OR error_rate > 0.5% over 1m, auto-demote to previous routing rule. I pushed policy snippet to the rollout:
```
{"rollback_conditions":[{"metric":"p50_latency_ms","threshold":300,"duration_s":60},{"metric":"error_rate_pct","threshold":0.5,"duration_s":60}]}
```
sylvie: note from last trial — reducing batch_window increased kvcache_miss ~12% on devcluster. If miss_rate > 10% for 2m, prefer pin back to old batch_window. :warning:
oncall-ops: oncall is on standby. Pager rules set: trigger if 5xx > 0.5% sustained 1m. Will DM escalation.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% at 1724600060. Metrics so far (summary): p50=120ms, p95=260ms, error_rate=0.02%, kvcache_miss=6%. No alerts.
zack: saw a brief tail blip to ~320ms at 14:38 for ~45s, correlates with a tenant burst. Not widespread.
alex: thanks — recommend holding canary and not promoting until we see 10m of stable tails. If it reappears, we'll pin affected tenant(s) to previous route: run 
```
curl -XPOST "https://admin.internal/pin" -d '{"tenant":"T-1234","route":"old-route","until":"+30m"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```
maya: agree. ops, can you be ready to run the curl if we need it?
oncall-ops: ready. I'll execute pin and notify. Also ready to rollback full traffic if error thresholds hit.
deploy-bot: Holding at 5% (canary) — 6m elapsed. Latest: p50=115ms, p95=240ms, error_rate=0.01%, kvcache_miss=7%. No auto-rollback triggered.
sylvie: thanks — still watching miss rate. If miss_rate climbs >10% for 2m we roll batch_window back to 50ms.
zack: consensus: hold for remaining 4m, then if stable, we can ramp to 25% for 10m before full promotion. No model pinning needed.
maya: ok, leave ramp plan in the rollout notes. I'll update the release notes with the exact params and rollback conditions. :memo:
deploy-bot: Canary hold complete at 1724600180. Next step pending — manual ramp to 25% scheduled if no major regressions in the next 4m.
